# Create a table


CREATE TABLE employees (
    emp_id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    emp_name VARCHAR(255),
    dept_id INT,
    salary DECIMAL(10, 2),
    bonus_percentage DECIMAL(4, 2)
);

# insert data

INSERT INTO employees (emp_id, emp_name, dept_id, salary, bonus_percentage)
VALUES
    (1001, 'xyz', 10, 25000, 8.5),
    (1002, 'abc', 20, 34000, 6.5);


# Calculate netsalary

SELECT emp_name,salary,bonus_percentage,salary+(salary*bonus_percentage/100) as net_salary FROM employees;
